plugins.name: markdown-orchestration
plugins.description: Markdown-tracked task orchestration: grill, decompose into a local git-ignored .orchestration/ markdown store (per-repo PROJECT.md, the epic as EPIC.md, chunks as issue files), and dispatch self-managing worker/reviewer subagents that write their own updates. No external service or account required. Engages via skill-discovery on matching non-trivial tasks.
